about: Crop phenology and sowing parameters for the 'This season' suggestions (GET .../season-records/:season/suggest). Every value is UNVERIFIED (verified: false): written from general extension knowledge and still to be checked line by line against the cited guide. The UI shows them as estimates. `source.url` and `accessed` stay null until someone opens the source and confirms the number. tBaseC: base temperature of the growing-degree-day sum (daily mean of Tmin and Tmax minus base, floored at 0). emergenceGdd: degree days from sowing to emergence, deg C d; absent = unknown. typicalEmergenceDays: fallback when no degree-day requirement is known, labelled 'typical'. sowingSoilTempC: minimum soil temperature (6 cm) for sowing, used only to pick the best date inside an open window.

tillage.about: Slope thresholds (percent) for the tillage suggestion: team rules of thumb read against NRCS 329; never mandatory. no_till from noTillSlopePct, reduced from reducedSlopePct; below that the regional practice (if any) decides.

us-southern-plains.note: Reduced or no-till is common on the semi-arid Southern High Plains to save soil water.

us-central-high-plains.note: No-till is widely used on Central High Plains dryland rotations.
